results.title: Disney Worldbuilders
results.overview: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

results.title: Expectation
results.overview: In a remote village of Anatolia, the dead body of a female doctor creates a deep curiosity among the villagers. The shepherd who didn’t confess his treatment because of his social fear, becomes the main suspect of the incident. Meanwhile for the lawyer the village he visited coincidentally to find peace gradually turns into darkness of expectations which are manipulating the truth or maybe it’s the truth hiding somewhere closer no one dares to look.

results.title: The Three Urns
results.overview: Back in his home country to spread the ashes of his beloved wife, a man races to his destination. In a milk float. Chased by a beautiful French woman in a smart car, plagued with battery issues.

results.title: A Fading Man
results.overview: When her ex-husband reappears, now suffering from dementia and having forgotten their divorce, Hanne’s orderly life with partner Bernd is gently upended.

results.title: Un renversement
results.overview: This film lifts the veil on the inner workings of women in politics, where everything happens far from microphones and official images. Through intimate and unfiltered testimonies from emblematic Quebec political figures, the film reveals the obstacles, struggles, and power dynamics that mark their journeys, while highlighting those who, despite resistance, forge new paths and redefine the contours of power.

results.title: Kidnapped: Elizabeth Smart
results.overview: Elizabeth Smart's harrowing abduction at 14 from her family's Utah home unfolds through her own words and never-before-seen material in this documentary.

results.title: Woven
results.overview: “Woven”, a documentary with a vibrant tapestry that unravels tradition and modern clothes. From the stunning landscapes of England to the rural Isaan region in Thailand, we'll uncover the stories behind traditional clothing. We'll delve into the environmental impact of fast fashion and celebrate the sustainability of traditional textiles, from the intricate embroidery of China Polano to the bold tartans of Scottish kilts. We'll explore the power of clothing to shape identity and challenge societal norms.

results.title: Please Try Again Later
results.overview: One night an unusually powerful solar storm hits the Netherlands, the paths of ambulance driver Alima and pretend student Bobbie cross. Under pressure from their failed attempts, the young women seek a way to achieve a happy ending.

results.title: Jenny
results.overview: Jenny, a young software professional from a coastal village in Kerala, returns home to spend a few days with her family before leaving for work. When a renovation forces her estranged grandfather back into her life, long-buried memories begin to resurface.

results.title: Apnea
results.overview: A sleep-deprived woman sets up a camcorder to record herself at night, hoping to prove something is visiting her, only to capture her own slow suffocation at the hands of an unknown entity.

results.title: Lust
results.overview: With formal rigour and subtly playing with genre, body and soul, this story of knots and liberation follows Lilian, who is as inscrutable as her desires, constrained by a pact of celibacy. When her father dies, she returns to the place of her past.

results.title: Above the Waterline
results.overview: In northern Chile, where the desert meets the ocean, a few solitary fishermen have made their home. Despite the arid land, the sea seems to offer them everything they need. It is a fragile balance, since this haven of freedom becomes an arena for military exercises every year.

results.title: Stronger Than the Devil
results.overview: Valentin is lost and penniless. He reunites with his son Joseph after 20 years of absence and plunges him and his wife Alice into total chaos. With JP, Mila and Gigi, the devil had better watch out...

results.title: Cruijff
results.overview: This four-part documentary series on the life of Johan Cruijff is an in-depth portrait of the man, the legend, and his enduring legacy.

results.title: Позывной «Аскет»
results.overview: A group of saboteurs infiltrates a chemical plant to carry out a terrorist attack. Their cunning plan is thwarted when a former Russian special forces officer with the call sign "Asket" crosses their path.

results.title: Hysterile
results.overview: A perfectionist takes an exam whilst being tested by her surroundings. Will she overcome these challenges, or crumble under the pressure?

results.title: Triegel meets Cranach
results.original_title: Triegel trifft Cranach - Malen im Widerstreit der Zeiten

results.title: VACANT
results.overview: When a new landlord inherits a run-down apartment complex, he expects late rent and repairs — not silence, and not the disappearances.  As tenants vanish one by one, he descends into the basement and discovers something still alive below the building.
